release_read.basis: Revenue $64.60B (+26%) clears the $63.3B consensus and the top of the $61-64B guide, Q4 guide $73-76B, 2026 capex only narrowed ($135-145B), Reality Labs losses to narrow to ~$15B next year and headcount -15%; the release gives NO 2027 capex number (the thesis line), only 'continue investing aggressively', so the call's 2027 framing is unread by me and caps the size well inside the 6.3% implied move.

release.released_at_note: Exhibit 99.1 dated 2026-10-21, after the close; exact minute not in the document. Call 4:30 pm ET (20:30 UTC).
release.headline: Meta Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

vs_bar.consensus_source: pre-charge estimates range $6.54-7.54 per https://cmsinvestments.substack.com/p/meta-q3-preview-the-2027-capex-number; no single consensus

key_line.detail: Release gives no 2027 capex or expense number; says Meta expects 'to continue investing aggressively' and Reality Labs losses to narrow to ~$15B next year. Consensus 2027 capex ~$193B (single source), banks at $200-225B. Any number given on the call was not verified here.

guidance.detail: Q4 revenue $73-76B (~1% FX headwind); 2026 capex narrowed to $135-145B from $130-145B; 2026 total expenses $175-179B, raised only for the legal charge. No 2027 guide in the release. Q4 revenue consensus not found.

call.detail: Call held last night. No transcript or call coverage found in the time available; the tape (after-hours +2.1% turning to -2.9% pre-market) suggests the call's 2027 spend framing reversed the release's positive read, but that is inferred from price, not verified.

public_reaction.summary: No post-release analyst actions or press coverage of the reaction found by search in the time available; search indexes returned only older capex stories.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 677.18 (-2.92%) against prev close 697.52; active pre-market (312 prints, 31 in the last 30 min, last 09:17, not stale). After hours peaked +2.1% (high 708.32) and the stock has since sagged to near the pre-market low 673.59. Market -0.7 to -0.9%, so about a third of the move is the tape. Against my release-only read of +3% it is an overshoot relative to the release, but the gap is plausibly the call, which I could not read; it is well inside the 6.3% implied move and smaller than the -8 to -11% of past forward-spend prints.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a 2027 spend shock. The release beat on revenue and gave no 2027 number, which on its own contradicts the short; the overnight turn from +2% to -3% says the call likely delivered the spend line, which would confirm it. Unverified.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market in a mega-cap, so the open should hold the -2.9% move; an amc gap of this size has had the whole night and tends to give part back by 10:00, partly offset by a weak market and the history of forward-spend prints extending lower.

recommendation.reason: De short staat ongeveer 4% in de winst en de daling na de cijfers is de hele nacht al verwerkt; na de opening geven zulke koersgaten vaak een deel terug. De cijfers zelf waren goed, dus de daling hangt op het verhaal over de uitgaven, dat ik niet kon controleren. Neem de winst bij de opening, zoals de standaardregel zegt.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als voor 09:30 analisten massaal hun koersdoel verlagen vanwege een 2027-investeringscijfer ver boven de 200 miljard en de voorbeurs onder 673 zakt, dan pas vasthouden tot het slot.
